measurement_discipline.protocol: 8 paired fresh processes, alternating order, 30 batches x 2000 constructions, 1000 warm-up operations; clock read twice per batch, never around a constructor.
measurement_discipline.same_source_control: Two independently built worktrees of the SAME reference commit are compared to establish an empirical cross-build noise floor (0.95-2.12% across runs). It has produced up to 3 spurious 'regression' verdicts from provably identical code, which is why a confidence interval excluding 1.0 is not by itself evidence at these magnitudes.
